notesA: p. 56: read only the two rows under 'PLATE XI.—Upper Register' (ārit ... semà); stopped at the rule before the Lepsius lines. p. 57 has 9 printed hieroglyph rows (not 10) and p. 58 has 9 (not 11) in this scan; all read. p. 59 read to 'Re - stau.' before 'The Fourth Ārit'. Margin labels First/Second/Third Ārit not recorded; hall field used; line numbers restart per hall (hall 1: 1-17, hall 2: 1-9, hall 3: 1-8). Words split across rows: àneb (O36 at start of p.57 row 9) and Qeq - ḥauatu - (G43 Aa2 Z2 at start of p.59 row 3) kept whole with the line of their first sign. The curled flat sign (upcurled left end, tab at right) is coded U15 throughout per the house ruling, though it acts as an arm determinative (user, θes, χesef, sati, Useṭ...); the same flat sign without the curl (tab only) is coded D36 where Budge reads ā (ārit, t'ābet, māk, sāḥ, maāt, Maāta). Seated figures: hand-to-face figure A2 (ren, semà, Qeq...), kneeling arm-raised figure A1 (nuk, suffixes), cloaked long-wig figure A40 (gods' names, ur, sāḥ). Overlines checked one by one: p56 ārit ṭep; ren (row 2 first); ren en (row 2 second); p57 t'eṭṭu àn; ārit ṭept; ànet'-ḥrà-k; neb à rer en; p58 ārit sen; ten ḥems-f ḥer / àrit ṭep em χemet ut'ā; p59 ārit χemt; t'eṭ àn. No hatched lacunae seen.
notesB: Section: p. 56 rows 3-4 only (under 'PLATE XI.—Upper Register.'), stopping at the horizontal rule; p. 57 all rows; p. 58 all rows; p. 59 rows 1-9 up to 'Re - stau.' before 'The Fourth Ārit. 1.'. My row counts: p. 56 2 rows read, p. 57 9 hieroglyphic rows (the brief says 10; its 'row 9 [D21 A1]' is my row 8, line 9 'er - à'), p. 58 9 rows (brief says 11), p. 59 9 rows (last row partial). Hall 1 lines 1-17 (p. 56 l.1 to p. 58 l.17); Hall 2 lines 1-9 (p. 58 to p. 59 row 1); Hall 3 lines 1-8 (p. 59 rows 2-9). Overlines (rubric): p. 56 ārit ṭep; ren (row 2, first); ren en (row 2, second); p. 57 t'eṭtu àn; ārit ṭept; ànet'-ḥrà-k; neb à rer en; p. 58 ārit sen (hall 2); ten ḥems-f ḥer; àrit ṭep em χemet ut'ā (overline ends just over ut'ā); p. 59 ārit χemt (hall 3); t'eṭ àn. Restorations: p. 56 [N35] en; p. 57 [D21 A1] er-à; p. 58 [àrit] (D4 X1); p. 58 [O34 O34] split between sati-s and Seqeṭ; p. 59 unχ [V12-like loop + U15]. (sic): p. 58 ent and Maāta (over N35); p. 59 at-f ((sic) beside N5). No hatched lacunae seen in Ani's text. Words split across rows: àneb (p. 57 row 8) continues with wall sign + -f on row 9 (recorded as a separate word '- f'); Qeq-ḥauatu- continues on p. 59 row 3 with G43 Aa2 Z2 (merged into the one word).
